summary: Minhajul has participated in numerous national, inter-university, and collegiate programming competitions, consistently achieving top rankings alongside exceptional academic performance.

verifiedAchievements.title: ICPC Dhaka Regional Contest 2025 Participant
verifiedAchievements.description: Competed in the prestigious International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC) Dhaka Regional Contest, representing Daffodil International University.

verifiedAchievements.title: NSU Inter-University Programming Contest (IUPC) 2026 Onsite Participant
verifiedAchievements.description: Selected and competed as an onsite participant at the North South University (NSU) Inter-University Programming Contest (IUPC).

verifiedAchievements.title: Unlock The Algorithm 2024: 2nd Place (Preliminary Round)
verifiedAchievements.description: Secured 2nd Place in the competitive preliminary round of Unlock The Algorithm 2024 at DIU.

verifiedAchievements.title: Unlock The Algorithm 2024: 7th Place (Final Round)
verifiedAchievements.description: Achieved 7th Place in the grand finale of Unlock The Algorithm 2024 among top university contenders.

verifiedAchievements.title: CodeTrap 2024: 4th Place
verifiedAchievements.description: Secured 4th Place in the CodeTrap 2024 programming competition.

verifiedAchievements.title: Breaking Code 2.0 (MBSTU): 9th Place
verifiedAchievements.description: Finished in 9th Place in the Breaking Code 2.0 inter-university contest organized by Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University (MBSTU).

verifiedAchievements.title: Take-Off Programming Contest 2023: 17th Place
verifiedAchievements.description: Achieved 17th place among hundreds of participants in the university-wide Take-Off Programming Contest at DIU.

verifiedAchievements.title: Codeforces Specialist (Peak Rating: 1432, Cyan)
verifiedAchievements.description: Attained official Specialist rank on Codeforces (handle: NoObMin), participating in 142 rated rounds across Div 2 and Div 3.

verifiedAchievements.title: AtCoder Green Tier (Peak Rating: 828)
verifiedAchievements.description: Reached Green tier rating on AtCoder (handle: NoObMin) through 33 rated AtCoder Beginner Contests.

verifiedAchievements.title: CodeChef 2-Star / Div 3 (Rating: 1429)
verifiedAchievements.description: Earned a 1429 rating on CodeChef (handle: NoObMin) competing in Division 3 contests.

verifiedAchievements.title: Academic Excellence – CGPA 3.87 / 4.00 at DIU
verifiedAchievements.description: Consistently maintained top percentile academic performance in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at Daffodil International University.

verifiedAchievements.title: PPS Lab Prefect Appointment
verifiedAchievements.description: Appointed as Lab Prefect for Programming for Problem Solving (PPS), guiding 100+ students through C/C++ problem-solving labs.

verifiedAchievements.title: Problem Setter & Associate Judging Director – DIU ACM Lab
verifiedAchievements.description: Selected to set and test contest problems and direct judging operations for official DIU programming contests.

verifiedAchievements.title: Volunteer – ICPC 2024 Dhaka Regional Contest
verifiedAchievements.description: Contributed to regional contest operations and logistics at the ICPC 2024 Dhaka Regional Contest.

verifiedAchievements.title: Volunteer – National High School Programming Contest (NHSPC) 2026
verifiedAchievements.description: Volunteered for the NHSPC Regional Round, assisting young students and supporting contest operations.

verifiedAchievements.title: 20 Verified Gallery Achievement Milestones
verifiedAchievements.description: Portfolio features 20 verified photographic records and certificates capturing contest stages, awards, and university recognition.
